title: Operational Technology Security Consultant
description:
About Coalfire

Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies navigate the ever-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S. and U.K., and we support clients around the world.
But that’s not who we are - that’s just what we do.
We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference.

Position Summary: The Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity Consultant assesses the security posture and maturity of OT environments for clients across manufacturing, energy, utilities, and other critical infrastructure sectors. This role involves conducting stakeholder interviews, reviewing OT documentation, evaluating security practices against industry frameworks, and developing maturity assessment reports with remediation recommendations. The Consultant presents findings and strategic guidance to clients while working with Project Managers, Directors, and Delivery teams to manage project scope and timelines.

What You'll Do

• Maintain current knowledge of OT security standards, regulatory developments, and industry trends through ongoing professional development and relevant certifications

• Support and guide OT risk and security discussions with technical teams, operations staff, and executive stakeholders

• Conduct stakeholder interviews and review OT-related policies, procedures, architecture documentation, and compliance records to understand organizational OT environments and priorities

• Assess client environments against OT security practices and compliance posture against IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, NIST CSF, NERC CIP, NIS2 Directive, EU Cyber Resilience Act, C2M2, and other relevant OT standards and frameworks

• Develop maturity assessment and benchmarking reports identifying OT security gaps, current state findings, and prioritized remediation recommendations

• Develop sequenced remediation roadmaps with prioritized activities, timelines, and implementation guidance to address identified OT security gaps

• Advise clients on OT security program structure, governance frameworks, organizational roles and responsibilities, and recommended policies and procedures

• Present assessment findings, risk analysis, and strategic recommendations to clients and their leadership through executive briefings and detailed reports

• Support other Cyber Risk Advisory consulting engagements when necessary to maintain team capacity

What You'll Bring

• At least 4 years of working experience in operational technology security, OT risk assessment, or related infrastructure security roles

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience demonstrating OT security expertise

• Direct experience in OT environments such as manufacturing, energy, utilities, or other critical infrastructure sectors

• Hands-on experience with Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems

• Knowledge of control system technologies, industrial automation architectures, and OT-specific networking environments

• Expertise in OT security assessment frameworks including IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and industry-specific requirements such as NERC CIP

• Understanding of emerging OT regulatory requirements including NIS2 Directive, EU Cyber Resilience Act, and other sector-specific directives

• Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities

• Strong oral and written communication skills when presenting technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

Bonus Points

• GICSP (Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional) certification

• CISM certification

• CIS

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Windchill Java Developer focused on deep, low-level Windchill customizations using Java, PTC APIs, and PTC’s customization frameworks. This role suits engineers who enjoy working close to the platform, extending its behavior through services, listeners, and processors while preserving a clean and upgrade-friendly customization layer. The ideal candidate will bring strong Java fundamentals, deep familiarity with the Windchill platform internals, and a disciplined, performance-aware engineering style. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

• Design and develop advanced Java customizations within Windchill, including custom services, listeners, processors, validators, and helpers.

• Build custom JSP and HTML extensions, including custom tables, actions, and wizard pages.

• Develop custom queues and background processes for asynchronous Windchill tasks.

• Collaborate closely with functional consultants to translate complex requirements into clean Java designs.

• Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation - including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures - so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.

• Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.

title: Information Security Officer
description:
The Role
As Group ISB, you own the information security strategy, programme, and posture of the Vektor Group, from strategy to hands-on execution. You work in close operational partnership with the Director of Internal IT on technical controls and implementation. Your core mandate is ISO 27001 certification on the basis of BSI IT-Grundschutz, together with NIS-2 compliance: from gap analysis and controls implementation through audit readiness, ongoing maintenance, and the regulatory obligations arising under both frameworks.
We build AI platforms for customers in the defence and government sector. Information security is a precondition for our business, not an afterthought. We are building the security organisation while the group grows. During this phase, everyone including leadership works hands-on: day-to-day operational security, direct support for the IT team, and tasks outside the boundaries of a traditional governance role. External consultants support the ramp-up. As the ISMS and the team mature, the balance shifts toward strategy and governance.
Your Responsibilities

• Build and operate the group-wide ISMS following BSI standards 200-1/200-2/200-3: structure analysis, protection needs assessment, modelling, risk analysis

• Create and maintain the security policy framework and processes at group level; coordinate company-specific additions

• Prepare and accompany ISO 27001 certification, run internal audits, work with external auditors

• Implement NIS-2 obligations: reporting processes, evidence management, corrective action tracking

• Manage risk across technical and organizational domains, including reporting to executive management

• Steer external consultants and service providers within the running programme

• Build and run the security awareness programme: training and sensitization

• Own incident response planning and coordinate during incidents, together with IT, Legal, and leadership

• Assess third-party and vendor risk, run security assessments for new tools and partners

• Work closely with the Director of Internal IT (technical controls: access governance, endpoint security, identity) and with platform engineering (interface to product security)

• Support sales and customer trust processes: security questionnaires, due diligence, customer audits

• Track further regulatory requirements (EU AI Act, Cyber Resilience Act, among others) and derive required action

What You Bring

• Several years of experience as an ISB or in comparable responsibility for information security

• Proven practice with BSI IT-Grundschutz: BSI standards 200-x and the Grundschutz-Kompendium, ideally including a completed certification procedure

• Experience building or leading ISO 27001 programmes, from gap analysis to audit readiness

• Solid risk management: you assess, prioritize, and communicate risk clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

• Willingness to work hands-on during the build-up phase

• Confident interaction with executive management, auditors, and customers

• German at C1 or above, English at B2 or above

Nice to Have

• Certifications: IT-Grundschutz-Praktiker/-Berater, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CISSP, CISM

• Experience with security governance across multiple legal entities or jurisdictions

• Experience in regulated environments: defence, government, critical infrastructure; familiarity with VS-NfD, Geheimschutz, or AQAP

• Practical NIS-2 implementation experience

• Experience with sales-adjacent security processes (pre-sales, customer audits)

What We Offer

• International team with colleagues across Germany and other locations.

• Startup environment with real ownership, flat hierarchies, and fast decisions.

• Competitive compensation aligned with experience and responsibility.

• Individual learning and growth opportunities beyond your role.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before? 

How we started:

Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza, HeliosX   was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.

Where we are now:

We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.

In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.

Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.

Where we’re going:

2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. Our ambition is to surpass £1.1bn in revenue, continue expanding thoughtfully into new international markets and broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. As we scale, we're focused on building the technology, operational excellence and clinical capabilities that will support sustainable long-term growth. Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. You'll be solving complex problems at pace, working alongside exceptional people and building products that genuinely improve lives at scale.

There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality!

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a highly organised and proactive Logistics Coordinator to join our Operations team and play a key role in the day-to-day management of final mile operations across all HeliosX brands and products. This role will work closely with our courier partners to coordinate collections, provide accurate forecasts and ensure deliveries run smoothly, while also supporting performance reporting, investigating delivery failures and managing compensation claims in line with our contractual agreements.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced environment, where attention to detail, strong communication and a proactive approach will make a real difference to our operational performance and customer experience.

This role will be based in our Leamington Spa Hub, with standard working hours of 9:00am-5:00pm, Monday to Friday.

What you'll do

• Reporting and Documentation: Maintain comprehensive records and provide regular reports on inbound and outbound shipments, inventory levels, returns, and overall logistics performance.

• Return Management: Manage the return process from couriers, including handling returns and coordinating with partners, finance, and customer service. Oversee return inventory processes such as disposition and refurbishment.

• Identify inefficiencies in the returns process and develop measures to reduce.  

• Collaboration: Build and maintain effective relationships with key stakeholders, including internal teams

title: Freiberuflicher Dozent (m/w/d) für den Bereich Zentrifugen
description:
Erfahrung weitergeben. Zukunft gestalten.
Jede berufliche Erfahrung kann den Unterschied machen. Genau deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die ihr Wissen weitergeben und die berufliche Weiterbildung aktiv mitgestalten möchten.
Warum TÜV Seminare Saarland?
Seit vielen Jahren begleiten wir Unternehmen und Fachkräfte mit hochwertigen Weiterbildungsangeboten in den Bereichen Technik, Management und Sicherheit. Unsere Seminare verbinden aktuelles Fachwissen mit einem hohen Praxisbezug - getragen von Expertinnen und Experten, die ihre Erfahrungen aus dem Berufsalltag einbringen.
Als Teil unseres Expertenkreises profitieren Sie von einer professionellen Organisation, einem etablierten Kundenstamm und einem starken Netzwerk. Sie konzentrieren sich auf das, was Sie am besten können: Ihr Wissen weitergeben. Wir übernehmen den Rest.
Aufgaben
Durchführung von Seminaren im Bereich Maschinen in einem oder mehreren der nachfolgenden Schwerpunktbereiche:

• Fortbildung zum Erhalt der Prüfsachkunde von Zentrifugen nach TRBS 1203 in Verbindung mit Fachbereich Aktuell FB RCI-025

• Zur Prüfung befähigte Person von Zentrifugen nach TRBS 1203 in Verbindung mit Fachbereich Aktuell FB RCI-025

Qualifikation
Fachliche Qualifikation (zwingend erforderlich)
Ein Dozent muss zwingend eine tiefgehende Fach- und Sachkunde nachweisen. Je nach Komplexität der Zentrifugen (z. B. Laborzentrifugen, Industrie- und Großzentrifugen in der Chemie oder Verfahrenstechnik) wird Folgendes gefordert:

•
Akademischer/Beruflicher Abschluss: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Biotechnologie, Physik oder eine Qualifikation als Techniker oder Industriemeister im relevanten Fachgebiet.

•
Sicherheits-Expertise: Exzellente Kenntnisse der gesetzlichen Vorgaben wie der Betriebssicherheitsverordnung (BetrSichV) , der TRBS 1203 (Technische Regeln für Betriebssicherheit) sowie der berufsgenossenschaftlichen Regelwerke (z. B. DGUV Regel 100-500, Kapitel 2.11 zu Zentrifugen).

•
Prüfkompetenz: Der Dozent muss in der Regel selbst die Kriterien einer "Zur Prüfung befähigten Person für Zentrifugen" erfüllen, um dieses Wissen rechtssicher an zukünftige Prüfer weiterzugeben.

•
Praxisnahe Tätigkeit: Mehrjährige, zeitnahe berufliche Erfahrung in der Konstruktion, dem Betrieb, der Wartung oder der sicherheitstechnischen Prüfung von Zentrifugen. Reine Theorie reicht bei technischen Schulungen selten aus.

•
Gefährdungsbeurteilung: Erfahrung in der Durchführung und Erstellung von Gefährdungsbeurteilungen speziell für den physikalischen Betrieb von Zentrifugen (z. B. Beherrschung von Risiken durch Fliehkräfte, Unwuchten und Materialermüdung).

Didaktische und Pädagogische Kompetenz

title: Operations Officer - Finance
description:
Position overview Avaaz is searching for a mission-driven Operations Officer (Finance) to join its multicultural and international team in a full-time role. The Finance team supports Avaaz ’s campaigns and global operations through accurate financial records, reliable payments and timely financial information. The role will support day-to-day finance operations across Avaaz ’s US and UK entities, including accounts payable, expense reporting, reconciliations and support for financial reporting and audits. You will take responsibility for assigned processes, provide cover across the team and help improve how we work as our systems and operations develop. The position calls for strong attention to detail, dependable follow-through and clear communication with colleagues and vendors. The Operations Officer (Finance) will report to a member of the Finance team.

Responsibilities

• Manage assigned payment and accounts payable workflows, including reviewing invoices, coding transactions and preparing payments across multiple platforms and currencies.

• Check that payments and expenses have the required approvals and supporting documentation, and follow up on missing information or discrepancies.

• Review credit card and expense reports and arrange or provide approvals within delegated authority.

• Apply the correct entity, currency, account and project coding, seeking guidance where the treatment is unclear.

• Maintain accurate accounting records and support bank, payment-platform and other account reconciliations, investigating and resolving differences.

• Support monthly and quarterly close, financial reporting and audits by preparing schedules, checking data and responding to information requests.

• Help maintain assigned financial trackers, such as revenue, grants, advances or budget expenditure, and flag discrepancies or outstanding items.

• Communicate clearly with vendors, colleagues and budget holders to resolve queries and obtain timely information, escalating delays or competing priorities early.

• Keep financial records and process documentation organized and accessible, and provide clear handovers and backup cover for colleagues, including payments.

• Apply and explain Finance policies, protect confidential information and follow agreed financial controls and compliance procedures.

• Contribute to process and system improvements through documentation, testing, data checks and adoption of approved tools and automation.

• Work with colleagues across Operations and campaigns on financial processes and undertake other appropriate Finance responsibilities as agreed.

Qualifications

The following list of qualifications is what we believe gives you the experience required to work in our environment and deliver on the responsibilities listed above. You should apply for this role if you believe you have the necessary experience, even if you don't meet all the requirements below:

• Practical experience in finance operations, accounts payable and/or accounting, with an understanding of reconciliations and financial controls.

• Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills and dependable follow-through.

• Good problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and know when to seek guidance.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, including tactful follow-up with colleagues and vendors.

• Strong teamwork skills and the ability to take ownership of assigned work within agreed responsibilities and approval processes.

• A growth mindset, willingness to learn and interest in improving financial processes.

• High professionalism and discretion when handling confidential financial and personal information.

• Ability to manage competing deadlines, communicate capacity constraints early and adapt to changing priorities in a remote team.

• Passion and commitment to global justice, citizen empowerment and social change.

• Confidence working with spreadsheets to organize, reconcile

title: Complaints Officer (FOS)
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

As we grow, we’re looking to expand our Complaints handling team. As an excellent communicator, you will quickly build relationships with customers and other departments across Lendable to understand customer friction points and come to fair and objective decisions.

If you have experience of either handling complex complaints (preferably motor or secured product related) or have worked in the automotive finance sector and have the following skills we’d love to hear from you:

- Problem solving and decision making skills - putting the customer at the heart of everything you do

- The ability to assess and critique evidence coming to a fair and comprehensive decision

- Be able to shift focus and re-prioritise workloads based on business and customer needs

- Great phone and written communication skills, being clear and concise to promote customer understanding.

- The ability to build rapport and manage multiple third parties including ensuring that customer expectations are managed.

Also, even better if you have:

- Experience of working in a regulated motor finance environment

- An understanding of the Consumer Rights Act 2015

- An understanding of Motor related policies and industry standards

- The ability to comprehend complex Satisfactory Quality-related complaints

- Strong experience working with the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS).

Your team’s objectives

Lendable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. Lendable is committed to providing excellent customer service and ensuring that it reaches the right outcomes for our customers.

Feedback is an important part of how we can evolve as a business to ensure that we are meeting our customers' expectations and continuously improving our service and the team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insights to the business in order to improve and grow.

Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers, and therefore to the benefit of us as a business, has never been more important than now; as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets.

How you’ll impact those objectives

The ideal candidate will have experience of resolving complaints or customer disputes within a regulated environment and have an aptitude for investigating, analysing, problem-solving and dispute resolution.

- You will be able to self manage a varied and complex caseload, identifying best contact mechanisms for customers

title: Senior Product Engineer

Conveo is a Y Combinator-backed company in an active growth period. We started this year as a team of ~20 and are on track to reach ~120 people by year end. The people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how this company is built.

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We’re investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.

The engineering team is small and deliberately so. There are no product managers, no designer handoffs, no tickets waiting for someone else to prioritise. Engineers own the full distance from customer problem to working software, and that proximity to the product is exactly what makes this role interesting. You'll report directly to one of our engineering leads, and work incredibly closely with our CTO, Maarten.

Dig deeper into our Engineering/Product ways of working 👉 here https://engineering.conveo.ai/engineering-at-conveo👈

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, and product teams.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We need a Senior Product Engineer who works backwards from the experience. This is someone who starts with the user's problem, not a spec, and owns everything between that conversation and the code that ships. You shape what gets built, actively contributing to product direction, influencing what we build and how we build it, with real technical and strategic impact.

Own the full stack, from the interface to the infrastructure

Build the interface customers open every day and can't imagine working without. React is the core of what customers see and touch - you lead frontend architecture in React and TypeScript, set the quality bar for components, state management, and performance. And you don't stop there. From API design to cloud infrastructure (AWS), you ship complete, polished features end to end, including AI-powered ones built on LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and async pipelines.

Be the engineering voice in every customer conversation

When a customer has a need, an engineer hears it, interprets it, and solves it. You join customer calls (about once a week), form a clear point of view on what to build, translate feedback into scoped product decisions, and follow through.

Use AI throughout

You reach for agentic solutions first. You use AI to reason, build, review, and test at every stage and you help raise the bar for how the whole team works. Documentation overhead doesn't slow us down here - AI handles that layer, and you're someone who is happy to work that way. You stay current on what frontier models can do and bring that into what we ship.

Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. ifeel | Internationaal platform voor mentale gezondheid
ifeel is een wereldwijd platform voor mentale gezondheid, actief in meer dan 90 landen. We werken vanuit een evidence-based klinische aanpak en zetten ons in voor het mentale welzijn van medewerkers.
We zijn op zoek naar Nederlandstalige GZ-psychologen met een geldige BIG-registratie die deel willen uitmaken van ons internationale netwerk en cliënten in Nederland flexibele, vertrouwelijke en hoogwaardige psychologische ondersteuning willen bieden.
Als GZ-psycholoog bij ifeel kun je cliënten ondersteunen via twee complementaire vormen van online therapie:
Videotherapie: online sessies van 40 minuten, die je inplant op basis van je eigen beschikbaarheid.
Teksttherapie: asynchrone schriftelijke communicatie waarmee je cliënten op een flexibele en doorlopende manier kunt ondersteunen.
Je wordt onderdeel van een internationaal netwerk van professionals in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg en krijgt toegang tot evidence-based klinische tools, ondersteuning van ons ervaren Clinical Team en een continue instroom van cliënten die aansluiten bij jouw expertise.

• Ervaring met telehealth, online therapie of digitale zorgplatforms .

Benefits
Wat bieden wij?

Modern online therapieplatform: Werk met geavanceerde digitale tools die zijn ontwikkeld om hoogwaardige psychologische zorg te ondersteunen.

•
Eenvoudig cliëntbeheer: Richt je op je cliënten, terwijl wij zorgen voor de instroom van cliënten en administratieve ondersteuning. Je hoeft geen marketingkosten te maken of een eigen website op te zetten.

Doorlopende training en ondersteuning: Profiteer van regelmatige trainingen, klinische begeleiding en mogelijkheden voor verdere professionele ontwikkeling.

Internationale community: Word onderdeel van een internationaal netwerk van professionals in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg en werk samen met collega's van over de hele wereld.

Betekenisvol werk: Maak een verschil binnen een groeiende en dynamische organisatie die zich inzet om mentale gezondheidszorg toegankelijker te maken.

title: Physical Product Planning Intern (all genders)
description:
Your role

We are looking for a physical product planning working student for 12 months at the heart of our Product team, where you will be responsible for supporting our operational and strategic needs for our physical product: meal kits. You will be central to our activity and will have a significant influence on our customers' meals.

We are looking for someone capable of assisting us in the operational planning of recipes at HelloFresh. This is a unique opportunity to learn and gain experience within a fast-growing company that is pioneering the food industry.

If you want to be a driving force in the growth of a scale-up, then this position is for you!

 

Your area of responsibility

• Menu creation and optimization: Assist the team in creating and optimizing menus using our python-based menu-planning algorithm.

• Product Improvement: You will work on several projects and initiatives that focus on improving our product offering aiming to increase customer satisfaction.

• Menu De-Risking: You will lead a number of cross-collaborative initiatives and processes aiming to reduce the menu risk and to ensure ingredient availability by considering the end-to-end value chain of our product. 

• Operations support: You support the team in day-to-day operations as well as with administrative and organizational tasks along the supply and menu planning process and have the opportunity to solve concrete problems, make decisions, and learn to manage real-world situations in a dynamic environment.

• Process management: You will participate in projects aimed at optimizing and automating and improving our product processes and supply chain by working with other teams.

• Reporting: You will track the weekly performance of menus and recipes, and conduct analyses on their monthly/quarterly performance.

• Recipe change management in menus: You will select alternative recipes when needed (ingredient shortage, marketing need, etc.).

• Recipe & Ingredient Pool management: You will contribute to the maintenance of the recipe and ingredient database in alignment with the culinary teams.

• Customization: You will support the expansion of our product offering by uploading and managing customized menu options to provide customers with greater choice.

 

Your profile

• You are completing a degree in Business Administration, Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline, ideally with a focus on Product Management, Supply Chain or Operations Management.

• Initial experience in product management or supply planning, CPG and E-Commerce experience is a plus.

• Excellent command of Excel; knowledge of SQL and Python is a real plus.

• A hands-on mindset and team spirit, which is very important as you will be working with many different people and teams.

• Fluency in English, German is a plus.

• Strong organizational skills, rigor, and great attention to detail.

• A proactive and ambitious mindset, with a desire to be part of a particularly dynamic business.

• Enthusiasm for the world of food and an interest in data are real assets for this job.

 

What we offer you

 

• Modern and comfortable working space with great co-workers in Berlin-Kreuzberg

• Discount for HelloFresh boxes and Convini products

• Extensive Onboarding and Buddy Program

• Social events including team events, Friday beers, company runs, book club, etc.

• Discounted fitness offers with our Urban Sports Club and John Reed partners, as well as yoga classes

• Well-being initiatives in cooperation with Headspace and Spill

• Monthly allowance for the Deutschlandticket

title: Head of Finance
description:
bunch https://www.bunch.capital/ is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

We are looking for our future Head of Finance to lead and scale our finance function. bunch has recently closed its Series B, is actively acquisitive, runs multiple entities across geographies and is building toward Series C and ultimately an exit.

This role owns capital, forecasting, budgeting, investor reporting, M&A finance, and EPR implementation and architects a function that scales from start-up to exit-grade, and gives you the opportunity to grow on a VP Finance track.

You will run the Finance function at a high-growth, VC-backed fintech at an inflection point, working directly with the founders and management team.

YOUR ROLE

- Own the full budgeting cycle end-to-end - top-down and bottom-up - working with the founders and management, department heads, and all teams. You'll run monthly variance reviews, drive quarterly budget control processes, challenge and sign off on procurement and vendor requests, and translate business strategy into financial plans with clear KPIs and milestones

- Build and maintain a robust cash forecasting model, providing regular management updates on burn rate and runway

- Prepare monthly and quarterly updates for board meetings, present financial performance to investors, and field questions on KPIs and progress

- Lead all financial aspects of equity rounds - modelling, due diligence management, and investor responses. Your first major milestone: get bunch Series C ready

- Manage financial due diligence on acquisitions, build M&A models, support target selection, and own Finance's role in post-merger integration

- Own bunch's banking relationships and build a strong network of German and European banking partners. Manage liquidity optimisation strategies and establish treasury policies for the group

- Scope and lead the implementation of an ERP system across the bunch group

- Act as primary liaison for all external bookkeeping, accounting, and tax advisory relationships - including cost reviews and optimisation

- Lead and develop the team; you’ll oversee financial operations and accounting team members and decide who to hire as the function grows

- Set the standard for excellence in the team, drive process optimisation and automation, and ensure Finance is a high-performing function that is a genuine driver of bunch's growth

ABOUT YOU

- 5+ years of progressive experience in an in-house finance role (ideally SaaS or VC-backed environment), PE, reputable management or financial consultancy, and/or investment banking; no previous Head of Finance experience required

- Track record of building robust financial models from scratch and comfort working with multi-entity and multi-currency structures

- Familiarity with accounting, billing, and spend management tools (e.g. DATEV, Stripe, Moss, Spendesk); experience with ERPs (NetSuite, etc.) is a plus

- If coming from an in-house environment, proven ownership of forecasting and budgeting cycles, not just supporting them

- Hands-on now, strategic later as the role grows into a VP level; wants to “do” and build from scratch, not just managing others

- Combines excellent technical expertise with the versatility, commercial flexibility and presence to be the strategic finance partner for management and represent

title: Investor Relations AI Researcher
description:
INVESTOR RELATIONS AI RESEARCHER

(Results Decks, Board Packs)

Full time | Remote - India

ABOUT US

Aptura is a London-based company working on understanding how AI is changing professional work. We look closely at how finance and advisory professionals actually work, and where AI helps or falls short. The company was founded by people with backgrounds at Lazard, McKinsey and Partners Group.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

We are looking for Subject Matter Experts from investor relations or FP&A who own the quarterly cycle of results decks, board packs and KPI reporting. You know that rolling a deck forward is never just swapping numbers.

You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make, or you simply want to find out how good they really are.

You will turn that experience into realistic PowerPoint tasks that test how well AI do the deck work of an IR or FP&A analyst.

RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE

- Writing realistic PowerPoint tasks drawn from your own reporting cycle: building decks from source documents, filling corporate templates, rolling decks forward and making precise edits

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing a yes-or-no checklist precise enough that an AI grader can mark any attempt against it

NECESSARY SKILLS INCLUDE

- 3+ years in investor relations, FP&A or financial reporting at a listed company or large corporate

- Deep hands-on PowerPoint: native charts, tables and corporate templates

- Ability to define what a correct deck looks like precisely enough for someone else to grade against it

- Clear writing. Tasks must be written by you, not by AI tools

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and data

HOW IT WORKS

1. Apply with your details and CV. After applying, verify your email and choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call. You can book immediately; there is no application-approval step before booking.

2. Attend the walkthrough and enter the code shared by the host at the end of the call to unlock your task workspace.

3. Create one original task from your own work in about 45 minutes. Submit the brief, the actual input files needed to complete it, a written expected result and at least five binary rubric checks, each with one skill tag. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

4. Write the brief and rubric yourself, without AI drafting, rewriting or polishing. Input materials must also be human-authored. Use only materials you are authorised to share, with confidential employer or client information removed.

5. Submit through your account for automated screening and team review. Follow any request for revisions in your account. Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to review.

Remote - India

title: Solutions Architect, Defence, DACH
description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

In this role as a Solutions Architect (SA) for Cohere in the DACH region, you will play an instrumental part in growing Cohere’s defence business across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the wider European region, with Germany as the main focus. You will partner with account executives, our partner ecosystem and executive leadership to help the region's defence and security organisations adopt AI securely and at scale, building on Cohere's success with organisations in defence and the public sector. These customers need AI that runs on their own infrastructure, often air-gapped or at the tactical edge, and that can handle classified information.

SAs at Cohere sit at the cross-section of Forward Deployed Engineering and AI transformation. Our SAs embody the following traits:

- Technical experts in the field

- Trusted advisors to customers and colleagues

- Product evangelists of Cohere technology

- Thought leaders in pushing the frontiers of applied AI

Responsibilities include developing a deep understanding of customer problems, mapping them to Cohere solutions, and working closely with our partners as the trusted technical advisor who owns the technical relationship with our stakeholders. By leveraging your expertise, you will help to increase the adoption of Cohere products, both internally and externally, and will gather valuable insights and feedback from customers to help shape the future of our products.

In this dynamic and demanding role, you will need to be both a strategic thinker and a builder. You will personally lead the design and deployment of customer pilots that showcase the impact of our technology to strategic enterprise and government customers.

You will own the customer's technical narrative end to end, from discovery and architecture to pilot results and business case, and bring structured customer feedback back to our Product and Engineering teams.

A typical day at Cohere might include:

- Leading the technical talk track on customer calls.

- Designing enterprise architectures for North deployments, including on-prem, air-gapped and sovereign cloud setups that meet German and EU requirements such as GDPR, BSI C5 and the EU AI Act.

- Designing for classified and disconnected environments (VS-NfD and above, air-gapped, DDIL and tactical edge), together with the customer's IT security and accreditation teams.

- Deep dives on customer queries and Cohere technology.

- Working with customer executives to prioritise use cases, define success metrics and build the business case for AI adoption.

- Translating defence and operational requirements into AI use cases, from logistics, maintenance and training to intelligence analysis and staff work.

- Facilitating customer evaluations and pilots inside their stack

- Owning the technical response of RFPs and public tenders, including defence procurement, from security questionnaires to mapping the customer's requirements specification (Lastenheft) to our solution.

- Developing and documenting processes to enable the solutions architect team and adjacent teams to scale effectively within Cohere.

About Respiris

Respiris is built to ensure that no one faces career transitions alone.
We are creating a modern alternative to traditional outplacement by combining human connection, structured coaching, community, and AI-enabled tools to support individuals during some of the most important and vulnerable moments of their professional lives.
We partner with companies to support employees with greater care, consistency, and credibility during workforce change. Respiris sits at the intersection of service, community, and technology, creating a model that is both deeply human and built to scale.
This is not legacy outplacement with a new label. This is a new category built for how work, networks, and transitions actually happen today.
About the Opportunity
Respiris is building a network of Founding Partners to activate and grow markets across the United States.
This opportunity is designed for experienced operators who have already generated meaningful independent revenue and want to add outplacement as a high-margin, relationship-driven revenue stream.
As a Founding Partner, you are not reselling a centralized service. You are building the market with us.
You will deepen relationships with existing clients, create new entry points into organizations navigating workforce change, and position yourself at the center of one of the most critical moments in the employee lifecycle.
This is an additional revenue stream designed to complement and expand your existing income portfolio.
What You’ll Do

• Build and activate a local market within your existing network

• Develop relationships with CHROs, Heads of People, CFOs, Legal leaders, Founders, and executives

• Position Respiris as a trusted partner for outplacement and transition support

• Generate introductions, referrals, and partner company relationships that convert into revenue

• Deliver structured coaching to individuals navigating career transitions

• Facilitate engagements across a three-month lifecycle (10 sessions per engagement)

• Host or support curated events (e.g., Stranger to Friends) to build trust and visibility

• Collaborate directly with the Founder on market activation and growth

• Use AI-enabled tools to improve execution, organization, and coaching quality

• Build a repeatable revenue stream layered into your existing work

Requirements
What Makes a Great Founding Partner

• You have experience as a Head of HR, HRBP, recruiter, advisor, or operator

• You have generated at least $50,000 in revenue under your own EIN (required)

• You understand how to build and manage client relationships

• You are trusted by senior decision-makers

• You are comfortable navigating sensitive employee transition moments

• You can turn relationships into revenue opportunities

• You are highly relational and commercially minded

• You are comfortable using modern tools and AI platforms

[Remote] Service Coordinator - Facilities Maintenance Dispatcher Description
Our client, a commercial services provider, is looking for a Remote Service Coordinator to join their team. In this role, you'll oversee work orders from initial intake through final closeout while serving as the primary point of contact between customers, technicians, vendors, and internal teams. You'll triage service requests, coordinate repairs, keep multiple systems updated, and ensure every job is completed accurately and on time. They're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, stays organized under pressure, and can juggle competing priorities without letting the details slip. While experience with overhead doors and loading dock equipment is ideal, they're also open to candidates from similar commercial facilities maintenance environments. They offer a lot of flexibility in terms of working from home, but not in terms of the pace. This is a high-volume, highly visible role where you'll be interacting with customers, technicians, vendors, and internal teams throughout the day. It's a great fit for someone who enjoys staying busy and thrives in an accountable, team-oriented environment.
[Remote] Service Coordinator - Dispatcher Responsibilities

• Manage work orders from intake through closeout
• Receive, triage, and prioritize incoming service requests
• Dispatch technicians and coordinate service providers
• Troubleshoot service issues and resolve remotely when possible

• Monitor ETA, NTE, and job progress

• Schedule preventative maintenance and timed work requests
• Update internal systems and client portals
• Collect job documentation, photos, and customer sign-offs
• Prepare quotes and proposals as needed
• Deliver exceptional customer service throughout the repair process

[Remote] Service Coordinator - Dispatcher Qualifications

•
4+ years of experience coordinating facilities maintenance technicians required
• Background supporting commercial building hardware such as overhead doors, loading dock equipment, plumbing, compactors/balers, or similar required
• Experience managing the full work order lifecycle, from intake through closeout, required
• Experience coordinating work orders, including ETA and NTE management, required
• Experience working across multiple systems utilizing dual monitors (or more) required
